provenance.why: MON-157 — no golden-baseline TREE had ever been committed to this repository, on any branch. Only hashes were kept, and diffBaselines() needs a tree on the old side. This is the first committed reference; it makes T3's G7 runnable. It does NOT close T2's G7 (see MON-157 / the ledger's T2 G7 row).
provenance.integrity: The reassembled tree was re-hashed with lib/matrix/goldenBaseline.ts:hashBaseline and matches the treeHash below EXACTLY — which also proves Call 1's capture and Call 2's capture were numerically identical, since they were separate server-side captures.

selfDiff.note: POST /golden-baseline/diff with this tree as baseline and expectedMoves: [] returned CLEAN — the capture→serialise→POST→flatten→verdict chain proven end to end before T3 depends on it.

provenance.knownNonFinding: The moneyFlowService tree is captured on the DECLARED loan basis and therefore understates its loan leg by $3,792.92/month, exactly as MON-156 declares. This is deliberate: a reference records TODAY's behaviour. One that quietly captured the better number would make the next tranche's diff report a move that never happened.
